the symmetric space sine-Gorden models are quantum equivalent to the GNO fermions with certain mass matrix, that these models can be formulated in terms of the path integrals of the WZW action with the field variable g taking values in certain orthogonal, unitary and symplectic representation of the group G, that the mass matrix is constrained by the integrability condition and that the non-Abelion solitons are identified with the GNO fermion zero modes.
the symmetric space sine-Gordan models are equivalent to the massive free fermion models, and the mass matrix for the latter is determined by the integrability of former.

the symmetric space sine-Gordan models are quantum equivalent to certain massive free GNO fermions, and the mass matrix for the GNO fermion is restricted by the integrability of its bosonic counterpart.

the quantum equivalence of the symmetric space sine-Gold model and the massive free-fermions introduced by GNO.
the bosonization of the massive GNO fermion system and the relation between massive fermions and the solitons.
a systematic investigation of the bosonic and fermionic degrees of freedom associated with the symmetric spaces.

the symmetric space sine-Gordan models are equivalent to the massive GNO fermion models in the sense that they have the same soliton content, which can be identified by the same method.
